recipes.name: Direwolf Bread inspired by Game of Thrones (feat. Maisie Williams)
instructions: Start by browning butter in a saucepan and then place it in a small bowl. Put in freezer until completely frozen. - ½ cup butter

Next combine whole wheat flour and all purpose flour. Add salt, baking powder, baking soda and white sugar. Whisk to combine. - 85 g whole wheat flour - 85 g all purpose flour - ½ tsp salt - 1 tsp baking powder - ¼ tsp baking soda - ¼ cup white sugar

Add your frozen butter to the dry mixture and use a pastry cutter or fork and knife to cut up the butter and combine it until butter pieces are about the size of a pea. Chop some sage and add that to the mixture as well. - 2 tbsp sage chopped
Toast about pecans and let them cool completely before adding to the mixture and tossing to combine. - 1 ⅓ cups toasted pecans
Add buttermilk and fold gently to combine. - ½ cup buttermilk
Flour your work surface and turn out your mixture. Work in the flour just a little bit before making it into a disc large enough to make a direwolf from it.
Cut the direwolf out from this template.
Brush the wolf down with a beaten egg and bake at 425°F for about 20 minutes or until golden brown. - ½ cup buttermilk
Cool on a rack. While it’s cooling, combine 2 parts butter to 1 part honey for a delicious honey butter mixture to put on your direwolf scone. - Honey - Butter
